=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md: Line 131 (Session titles section) vs lines 53, 67, 73, 77 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The Session titles rule says steps 3a, 6, 8, 10, 11, and 12 rename themselves when opening a PR, but steps 8, 10, 11, and 12 have no explicit rename instructions.
  WHY: A stage that opens a PR in any of those four steps will not rename itself as documented, so the operator cannot match the session to its PR.
- tests/test_session_titles.py: lines 70-75 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The test checks the rename documentation and instructions for steps 3a and 6, but not the other four steps named by the rule.
  WHY: Severity disagreement: deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and qwen_qwen3_7-plus rated this NIT, while x-ai_grok-4_20 rated it MAJOR; a passing test therefore leaves the documented behavior gap undetected.
- CLAUDE.md: 1971-1974 | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The merged-session terminal rename instruction was deleted instead of being updated to include the required `#<issue> · ` prefix.
  WHY: The merged terminal report form is undocumented, allowing inconsistent session naming where merged reports omit the issue prefix used by closed reports.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md: lines 147-153 and lines 121-137 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The Session titles section links to `#archiving-the-project-checker`, but the diff removes the `### Archiving the project checker` section.
  WHY: The link leads nowhere, and the removed section's safety-check details are no longer documented there.
- tests/test_check_in_session_targeting.py: lines 108-114 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The test still reads the removed `### Archiving the project checker` section and asserts content from it.
  WHY: `_section` returns an empty string when the section marker is absent, so the assertions fail for both the twin and non-twin cases.
- .claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md: lines 70-73 (removed in the diff) | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The non-twin removes the “Rename and archive only the right session” safety rule that remains in the twin.
  WHY: During the interim twin-first window, a fixer reading the non-twin lacks the in-file guard against renaming or archiving the wrong session; the PR description acknowledges this interim risk.
- tests/test_session_titles.py: `test_checker_matchers_accept_both_title_forms` plus the parametrised `test_checker_titles_old_new_and_hand_prefixed_all_match` and `test_checker_matcher_rejects_other_slugs_and_stages` blocks | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The checker title tests do not cover a checker title renamed by hand with the issue number mid-string, despite the Session titles rule promising to accept hand-renamed titles.
  WHY: The listed positive cases cover documented title prefixes for the same checker title, while the near-miss cases do not test a hand-renamed mid-string variant.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "A stage renames itself on PR open" and the Session titles rule says a stage that opens a PR in steps 3a, 6, 8, 10, 11, and 12 renames itself in that same step.
  expected_change_site: workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md and .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md, steps 8, 10, 11, and 12; alternatively, narrow the rule and test scope to steps 3a and 6.
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20, z-ai_glm-5_2]

Nothing in step 8 (around line 53), step 10 (around line 67), step 11 (around line 73), or step 12 (around line 77) references the titles section or asks the session to rename; Greps for `set_session_title|rename this session|renames itself` in `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` find renames only in step 3a (line 25), step 6 (line 38), and step 13's `create_session` title spec (line 83); no rename text appears in step 8, step 10, step 11, or step 12; Greps for `set_session_title|rename this session|renames itself` in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md find renames only in step 3a (line 25), step 6 (line 38), and step 13's `create_session` title spec (line 83); no rename text appears in step 8 (line 53), step 10 (line 67), step 11 (line 73), or step 12 (line 77); Grep for `rename this session|renames itself` in `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` finds explicit rename instructions only in step 3a (line 25) and step 6 (line 38); step 13's `create_session` title spec (line 83) covers the `/deploy-activate` session, not a stage's PR. Steps 8, 10, 11, and 12 open PRs on `claude/implement-plan-<slug>-{conformance,validation,activation}-fix-…` and `-complete` branches but contain no `set_session_title` text; Greps for `set_session_title|rename this session|renames itself` in workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md find renames only in step 3a (line 25), step 6 (line 38), and step 13's create_session title spec (line 83); no rename text appears in step 8 (line 53), step 10 (line 67), step 11 (line 73), or step 12 (line 77). The test test_stage_renames_itself_when_it_opens_a_pr only asserts the documentation line plus the 3a/6 renames and does not assert the additional four steps; Grep for `rename this session|renames itself` in `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` finds explicit rename instructions only in step 3a (line 25) and step 6 (line 38); step 13's `create_session` title spec (line 83) covers the `/deploy-activate` session, not a stage's PR. Steps 8, 10, 11, and 12 open PRs on `claude/implement-plan-<slug>-{conformance,validation,activation}-fix-…` and `-complete` branches but contain no `set_session_title` text. `tests/test_session_titles.py::test_stage_renames_itself_when_it_opens_a_pr` asserts only the documentation line and the 3a/6 rename text, leaving the four-step gap unverified.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

  PROBLEM: The Session titles rule names six PR-opening steps, but only steps 3a and 6 carry an explicit rename instruction.
  WHY: A stage in step 8, 10, 11, or 12 that opens a PR will not rename itself, so the operator cannot match the session to its PR from the first characters of the sidebar title.

  WHY: During the interim twin-first window, a fresh interactive session reading the non-twin has no guard against the wrong-session rename pattern; this is acknowledged as an interim risk in the PR description.

- TASK_GAP

Nothing in step 8 (around line 53), step 10 (around line 67), step 11 (around line 73), or step 12 (around line 77) references the titles section or asks the session to rename. The test test_stage_renames_itself_when_it_opens_a_pr only asserts the 3a/6 rename text and the documentation line, not the additional four steps.
  SEVERITY: high
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
